headline: Online IGCSE & A-Level Physics tutor based in Tripoli
blurb_for_parents: Hi — I'm Mahmoud. I teach IGCSE and A-Level Physics to international school students, with a focus on Pearson Edexcel. I'm currently completing my PGCEi (international PGCE) through Liverpool John Moores University while teaching full-time at a registered British examination centre in Tripoli. My lessons are structured around your exam board, with model-led problem solving and required-practical drill where it actually moves grades. The first 30 minutes are always free — no charge, no obligation — so we can both see whether I'm a good fit before you commit.
qualifications_summary: B.Sc. Mechanical Engineering (University of Tripoli, 2020). PGCEi candidate (Liverpool John Moores, 2025–2026). Three years' post-qualifying classroom experience teaching Pearson Edexcel IGCSE and A-Level Physics at Vision International School (registered Pearson Edexcel examination centre) in Tripoli.
intro_session_promise: Free, no-obligation 30-minute session to map the syllabus gap and confirm fit before any payment.
anti_promises_or_qualifications: I don't guarantee specific grades — I commit to clear, structured, board-aligned teaching and honest feedback on progress.
I'm a teacher, not a homework-completion service. Ethics and exam-board rules apply.
style_notes: Plain British English, no marketing fluff.
Parents value directness: lead with the diagnosis, not the credentials.
Gulf-parent audience tends to be results-led; UK-parent audience tends to be pastoral-led. Tone adapts via voice_warmth_target, not by hard-coding market.
